about.description:
The Computational Crystallography Toolbox (cctbx) is being developed
as the open source component of the Phenix system. The goal of the
Phenix project is to advance automation of macromolecular structure
determination. Phenix depends on the cctbx, but not vice versa. This
hierarchical approach enforces a clean design as a reusable library.
The cctbx is therefore also useful for small-molecule crystallography
and even general scientific applications.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2026.10"

recipe:
  name: cctbx-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/cctbx/cctbx_project/releases/download/v${{ version }}/cctbx-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0f157a793f5a156308e2ab306aa81a840a8f5c4461ebd676dec3e3bfb22e77e2
  patches:
    - cbf.patch
    - dxtbx.patch
    - libann.patch
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: libtbx_osx-arm64.patch
    - libtbx_SConscript.patch
    - tst_guided_coding.patch

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: cctbx-base
    build:
      script:
        file: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: unix
          then: gnuconfig
      host:
        - libboost-python-devel
        - libboost-devel
        - eigen
        - future
        - if: linux
          then: libglu
        - numpy
        - pip
        - python
        - if: osx
          then: python.app
        - scipy
        - scons
        - setuptools
        - six
        - if: linux
          then:
            - xorg-libxfixes
            - libgl-devel
      run:
        - biopython
        - future
        - if: linux
          then: ${{ pin_compatible('libglu') }}
        - libsvm
        - matplotlib-base
        - mrcfile
        - pillow
        - psutil
        - python
        - if: osx
          then: python.app
        - pyyaml
        - reportlab
        - requests
        - scipy
        - six
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - scitbx.array_family.flex
            - if: not win
              then:
                - gltbx.gl
                - gltbx.glu
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - libtbx.show_commands
              - mkdir test; cd test; libtbx.run_tests_parallel module=cctbx module=libtbx module=scitbx nproc=4
          # dispatchers are .bat files on Windows; without call, cmd never
          # returns from them and the rest of the script is skipped
          - if: win
            then:
              - call libtbx.show_commands
              - mkdir test && cd test && call libtbx.run_tests_parallel module=cctbx module=libtbx module=scitbx nproc=4

  - package:
      name: cctbx
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('cctbx-base', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ipython
        - if: (x86_64 or arm64 or aarch64) and match(python, "<3.14")
          then:
            - pyside2
            - qt-webengine
        - pyopengl
        - python
        - pyzmq
        - websockets
        - if: x86_64 or arm64 or aarch64
          then: wxpython
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - scitbx.array_family.flex
            - gltbx.gl
            - gltbx.glu
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: libtbx.show_commands
          - if: win
            then: call libtbx.show_commands
          - if: osx
            then: libtbx.python -c "import wx; wx.App()"
          - if: win
            then: call libtbx.python -c "import wx; wx.App()"
          - if: unix
            then: mkdir test; cd test; libtbx.run_tests_parallel module=cctbx module=libtbx module=scitbx nproc=4
          - if: win
            then: mkdir test && cd test && call libtbx.run_tests_parallel module=cctbx module=libtbx module=scitbx nproc=4
